entries.name: Real estate owned
entries.definition: Property that a lender owns after it fails to sell at a foreclosure auction, and the work of managing and reselling it.

entries.name: Real-time payments
entries.definition: Payment systems that clear and settle transfers between bank accounts within seconds, at any hour, such as the RTP network and FedNow.

entries.name: Receptive and expressive language
entries.definition: The two sides of language ability studied in speech-language pathology: understanding what others say or write, and putting thoughts into words.

entries.name: Recruitment consulting
entries.definition: Advising employers on hiring and finding, screening and placing candidates for them.

entries.name: Red teaming
entries.definition: Playing the part of an adversary to test how well an organisation, system or AI model withstands attack or misuse.

entries.name: REDCap
entries.definition: A web application, developed at Vanderbilt University, for building and managing online surveys and research databases.

entries.name: Reduction (complexity)
entries.definition: A way of converting one problem into another so that a solution to the second gives a solution to the first, used in complexity theory to compare how hard problems are.

entries.name: Reference range
entries.definition: The range of values for a laboratory test that is expected in healthy people, used to judge whether a result is normal.

entries.name: Refrigerated transport
entries.definition: Moving perishable or temperature-sensitive goods in vehicles or containers that keep them cold.

entries.name: Refrigeration
entries.definition: The technology and practice of removing heat to keep a space or product colder than its surroundings, as in cold rooms, freezers and chillers.

entries.name: Refrigeration compressors
entries.definition: The machines that compress refrigerant gas in a refrigeration system so that it can circulate and carry heat away.

entries.name: Refugee issues
entries.definition: Understanding the legal, social and humanitarian circumstances of people forced to flee their countries, and the services that support them.

entries.name: Registered Education Savings Plan
entries.definition: A Canadian government-registered savings account, with grants, for a child's education after high school, and the planning of contributions to it.

entries.name: Regulation SHO
entries.definition: A U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regulation governing short sales of securities, including locate and close-out requirements.

entries.name: Regulatory CMC
entries.definition: Preparing and managing the chemistry, manufacturing and controls information that regulators require in applications for drugs and biological products.

entries.name: Rehabilitation
entries.definition: Treatment and training that help a person recover or regain abilities and independence lost through injury, illness, disability or addiction.

entries.name: Reinforced masonry
entries.definition: Masonry construction in which steel bars or mesh are embedded in mortar or grout so that walls resist tension, bending and earthquake loads.

entries.name: Reinforcement learning
entries.definition: Learning policies from interaction and reward feedback.

entries.name: Relational database management system
entries.definition: Software that stores data in tables of rows and columns linked by keys and is queried with SQL, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle Database.

entries.name: Reltio
entries.definition: A cloud master data management platform that unifies and manages customer, product and other business data from many sources.

entries.name: Renal nutrition
entries.definition: The study and practice of dietary care for people with kidney disease, including limits on protein, potassium, phosphorus, sodium and fluid.

entries.name: Renewable energy
entries.definition: Energy from sources that are naturally replenished, such as sunlight, wind, water and geothermal heat, and the technology used to harness it.

entries.name: Renewable energy sales
entries.definition: Selling renewable energy products or services, such as solar systems or clean power contracts.

entries.name: Reporting
entries.definition: Gathering information and presenting it in regular or one-off reports for others to use.

entries.name: Representational State Transfer
entries.definition: An architectural style for web services in which resources are identified by URLs and handled with standard HTTP methods.

entries.name: Reproductive health care
entries.definition: Care that supports sexual and reproductive health, such as contraception, pregnancy care, fertility care and screening.

entries.name: RequireJS
entries.definition: A JavaScript file and module loader that implements the Asynchronous Module Definition format for browsers and Node.js.

entries.name: Research methodology
entries.definition: The principles and methods for designing and carrying out research, including how data is collected and analysed.

entries.name: ReSharper
entries.definition: A JetBrains extension for Microsoft Visual Studio that adds code analysis, quick fixes and refactoring for .NET developers.

entries.name: Residential construction
entries.definition: Building homes and apartment buildings, as distinct from commercial or industrial construction.

entries.name: Resilience planning
entries.definition: Planning how an organisation, community or system will keep working through shocks such as disasters, outages or climate events, and recover afterwards.

entries.name: Resolving guest concerns
entries.definition: Dealing with a guest's complaints or problems, especially in hotels and restaurants, so that they are put right.

entries.name: Resorcerer
entries.definition: A resource editor for classic Macintosh software, used to view and edit the resources stored in application and system files.

entries.name: Resource mobilization
entries.definition: Raising and bringing together the funds, people and materials an organisation or programme needs, especially in non-profit and development work.

entries.name: Responsibility assignment matrix
entries.definition: A table that maps the tasks of a project to the people or roles responsible for them, often using codes such as responsible, accountable, consulted and informed.

entries.name: Responsive teaching
entries.definition: Adjusting instruction as a lesson happens, in response to what students say, do and need.

entries.name: REST API security
entries.definition: Protecting RESTful web services, for example with authentication, authorisation, encryption and input validation.

entries.name: Restaurant management
entries.definition: Running a restaurant's daily operations, including staff, service, purchasing, food safety and finances.

entries.name: Restorative justice
entries.definition: An approach to wrongdoing that focuses on repairing the harm done, by bringing together victims, offenders and the community, rather than only punishing.

entries.name: RethinkDB
entries.definition: An open-source distributed document database that can push changes in query results to applications as the data changes.
